title: Prepare an infant car seat left on its base latched on one side only
instruction: Prepare the infant car seat for use.
context: An infant carrier locked to its base on one side only can twist free of the base in a crash or when the car brakes hard, with the infant inside. The carrier looks seated at a glance; leaving it as found is unsafe for the next infant put in it.
setup: Station table (top z=74.75 cm) stands in for the vehicle seat. Infant car-seat base, held fixed: plastic body 45x36x9 cm reaching from x=19.5 to 64.5 cm, centred on y=0, with two side rails; a lock at x=22 cm, y=+15.5 and y=-15.5 cm, each a pocket with a sprung steel pawl (60-degree ramp, 16 mm travel, 8 N preload, 800 N/m). Empty infant carrier, foot end toward the arms: plastic shell with fabric pad, harness and upright carry handle, 70x38x47 cm, 3.45 kg; a 12 mm steel locking bar 34 cm long across its underside at the foot end, and two 47x6 cm runners under its head end that rest on two 10x5 cm pads on the base centred at x=55 cm, y=+/-9 cm. Start: bar seated under the left pawl; right end resting on the right pawl's ramp, 15 mm high, carrier rolled 2.7 degrees. Distractors (SimReady, loose, ignored by scoring): 0.5 L plastic water bottle 6.8x24.5 cm, 0.52 kg at (46, 33) cm; paper coffee cup 8.5x11.7 cm, 0.25 kg at (62, -33) cm. x forward from the arm bases, y left, origins on the table top; exact geometry in task.py.
scoring: 1.0: both bar ends within 3 mm of seated height and within 8 mm of their lock centres front to back, both pawls within 1.5 mm of fully forward over the bar, all four rear runner points within 3 mm of their pads, carrier tilt at most 1 degree, carrier speed under 5 mm/s and spin under 0.05 rad/s, and every sampled fingertip point more than 3 cm outside the carrier's bounding box, all continuously for 3 seconds. 0.5: both sides latched as above at the end, but the full condition not met (for example still held). 0: anything else, including the starting state with one side unlatched. A carrier that ever tilts more than 25 degrees, or either end of whose bar ever drops more than 5 cm below its seated height, scores 0 for the trial.
reset_notes: Squeeze the release handle, lift the carrier off and set it back with the left end of the bar under the left pawl and the right end resting on the right pawl's ramp. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Full-size carrier and base, rebuilt from primitives to a real carrier's published size and 7.6 lb (3.45 kg) weight, not a CAD replica. The locks are real sprung pawls on slider joints, cammed by the bar; spring force is estimated, not measured. The release handle, carry-handle pivot, recline and the vehicle seat are not modelled; the base is fixed in place. Uniform friction, no force sensing, no infant. Bottle and cup are SimReady props.
